data.name: Adventurers Guild
data.detailed_description:
"The 2026 Tribal Adventure MMORPG is Now Available!

Answer the Call of the Wild. Start Your Hunt Now!"

Lore

"Parmons, once guarded by gods and ancient dragons, was plunged into darkness by the invasive evil dragon Niro.

With their sacrifice, the gods and dragons sealed him away, preserving the world's glory.

Now, as Niro stirs anew, you—an adventurer of the Howling Dragon Tribe—must rise, lead your tribe and sacred beasts to safeguard the continent's fate."

Features

"▶ Boundless Hunting Ground

From dense rainforests to dragonbone deserts, explore a vast world blessed by gods and ancient dragons—yet filled with danger. This is your ultimate hunting ground, where every corner hides treasures, secrets, and powerful foes waiting to be conquered."

"▶ Catch Pets Freely

Encounter and tame a wide variety of magical creatures in the wilds, abysses, and hidden realms of Pamons. They are not only pets, but trusted companions who fight fiercely by your side throughout your journey."

"▶ Evolve & Ascend

Your pets have unlimited potential! Through battle and nurturing, help them evolve to unlock stunning new forms and devastating skills. Create a one-of-a-kind ultimate pet to take on the coming threats together."

"▶ Join A Tribe

Evil can't be stopped by one alone. Call upon allies and form an ultimate hunting party. Team up with players of different classes, devise strategies, and experience true MMORPG camaraderie in intense co-op battles."

"▶ Slay The Boss

Nihilo, the sealed evil dragon, has returned, and the world is once again at risk. Confront massive bosses from the otherworld with breathtaking skills and feel the thrill of the hunt. Every strike you make will shape the fate of Pamons."
